title: Steiner symmetrization of a compact set is compact
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, j ∈ Fin d and let A ⊆ ℝ^d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) be compact. Let A^j_y := {t ∈ ℝ : y[j↦t] ∈ A}, where y[j↦t] is y with its j-th coordinate replaced by t (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t)), and λ(y) := (L¹(A^j_y)).toReal. If λ : ℝ^d → ℝ is upper semicontinuous, then the Steiner symmetrization S_j(A) := {y ∈ ℝ^d : A^j_y ≠ ∅ and |y_j| ≤ λ(y)/2} is compact.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (j : Fin d) (A : Set (Euclid d)), IsCompact A → UpperSemicontinuous (fun y : Euclid d => (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal) → IsCompact {y : Euclid d | {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}.Nonempty ∧ |y j| ≤ (volume {t : ℝ | WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update y.ofLp j t) ∈ A}).toReal / 2}
